title: Real analytic lift of foliations of Thurston and Tsuboi
summary: Thurston constructed codimension one foliations on $S^3$ thereby proved that the homomorphism $gv: π_3(B\overlineΓ^\infty_1)\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ induced by the Godbillon-Vey invariant is surjective. By another real analytic construction, he proved that the homomorphism $gv: H_3(B\overlineΓ^ω_1)\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is also surjective where $B\overlineΓ^ω_1$ is a $K(π,1)$ space by Haefliger. Tsuboi proved that the former surjection splits so that $π_3(B\overlineΓ^\infty_1)= \mathbb{R}\oplus \mathrm{Ker}\,gv$. He further showed that the subgroup of $H_3(B\overlineΓ^\infty_1;\mathbb{Z})$…
